IS 6500 : 2026 Thermometer for Measurement of Sea Surface Temperature - Specification
ICS 17.200.20
ICS 17.200.20
CHD 10
CHD 10
1 SCOPE
This standard prescribes the requirements for thermometer for measuring the temperature of water at the surface layers of the sea.
2 REFERENCE
The standards given below contain provisions which through reference in this text, constitute provisions of and necessary adjuncts to this standard. At the time of publication, the editions indicated were valid. All standards are subject to revision and parties to agreements based on this standard are encouraged to investigate the possibility of applying the most recent edition of these standards indicated.
